snippet.title: KUPALA — Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
It is a dark, non-linear horror visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore.
Little Anya arrives at a village on the eve of Kupala Night — the sacred night of the ancient Slavs. In the quiet old house, her grandmother tells her tales of unclean spirits crossing into the living world...
KUPALA will be fully released on September 4, 2026. 
A free 30-minute demo is available on Steam.
Full version on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4037300/Kupala/
Developed by Marianna Petrova.
